title: C# Async/Await
description: Async and Await are used to handle long-running operations without blocking the main thread.

challenges.title: Task Keyword
challenges.exercise: Write a method signature for 'DoWorkAsync' that returns a Task of string.

challenges.title: Awaiting a Task
challenges.exercise: If you have a Task<int> named 'task', how do you wait for its result? Print the result of awaiting 'task'.
